implementation.event: Saving a user-visible profile field creates a persisted notification for each accepted friend and publishes the committed row over the existing notification WebSocket event.
implementation.consent: shareProfileUpdates defaults on for compatibility; an explicit false prevents all new profile-update notifications.
implementation.separation: Language and DM privacy-only edits do not create profile-update notifications, and notification fan-out failure does not falsely report that the already-committed profile edit failed.
implementation.client: The Data and privacy switch is account-synced, and inbox system rows with action=profile_update render a localized actor headline.

remaining_acceptance: Use two accepted-friend browser accounts to confirm on/off delivery, persistence after reload, and that disabled sharing does not affect saved profile edits.
